messages:
aisha_csm: Heads up — Meridian Health renewal is in 6 weeks and they're reporting latency spikes after moving a couple of models. We should run a targeted office hours + hands-on migration workshop to move their critical endpoints to Dedicated and go over routing/fallbacks. Renewal risk > discuss.

tom_enable: I'm available next Tue/Wed. Prefer hands-on lab format: 30m triage, 60m guided migration, 30m Q&A and next steps. Agenda draft below.

josh_sales: +1. Sales wants an enablement summary doc to share with the exec sponsor post-workshop. Also need a calendar invite with join info and expected attendee list.

claire_ops: Who from runtime/infra should join? We should have someone who can signal in real-time if we need a config tweak (autoscaling or cache policy).

aisha_csm: @tom_enable, @claire_ops can you both cover runbooks? I can own customer questions and success criteria. @josh_sales can you confirm exec sponsor will attend for the first 15m?

tom_enable: I'll prep lab steps and a minimal env with sample model and pinned version. Plan uses Dedicated staging pool and a canary rollout. Draft agenda:
```
- 0-30m: Health triage (latency traces, cost spikes)
- 30-90m: Migration lab (deploy to Dedicated, config batching, KV cache tests)
- 90-120m: Fall-back policies, monitoring dashboard walkthrough, Q&A
- Post: Share runbook + exec summary
```

josh_sales: Exec sponsor confirmed for first 20m. Also requested an ROI slide with expected cost delta for Dedicated vs hosted + risk mitigation notes.

claire_ops: I'll bring @runtime_oncall (if available) and a short checklist. Checklist items: ensure model quantization compatibility, session affinity settings, KMS access, network egress rules.

aisha_csm: Preference poll — what slot works for Meridian? React with :one: for Tue 4pm PT, :two: for Wed 10am PT, :three: for Thu 9am PT.

josh_sales: :one:

tom_enable: :one:

claire_ops: :two: (could do Tue but prefer Wed)

enablement-bot: Calendar invite created: "Meridian Health — Hands-on Dedicated Migration" Wed 10am PT — invite sent to: meridian_cs@client.com, josh_sales, aisha_csm, tom_enable, claire_ops, runtime_oncall.ics

aisha_csm: Great — Wed 10am PT it is. Tom, please post the lab prereqs doc in this thread by EOD tomorrow. I'll prepare the executive summary template and ROI calc. Agenda final after lab doc.

tom_enable: Will do. Quick lab prereqs snippet below — plz review:
```
- Access: meridian service account with model-read + deploy
- KMS: key id for model decryption
- Dedicated pool: 2 GPUs reserved for staging lab
- Test prompts: 5 prompt set (latency-sensitive)
- Telemetry: tracing enabled with trace_id header
```

josh_sales: Also add contact for escalation during the session (oncall + customer success mobile).

aisha_csm: Noted. Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a pre-read and attendee list. If anything changes ping me here. :thumbsup:
